BiblicalUsage: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God has shined. The word is perfection itself, and the psalmist puts it on Zion, the place God chose for His name.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Zion is called the perfection of beauty because God shines from it: the beauty is not the city's, it is the light of the God who dwells there.
